name: Pattern 4: Resource Implementation
description: Models the implementation relationship between a resource and the agent that produced it: a MatWerk project is a process whose participant (task area, infrastructure use case or participant project) realizes a role, and whose output is an NFDI resource such as a dataset, tool, software or digital service. The shortcut property mwo:implementedBy links the resource directly to the process that produced it.
competency_questions: Which tools were developed, co-developed, or adopted in an organization?
